Package io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics

Class MetricsAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics.MetricsAutoConfiguration
@Configuration @EnableConfigurationProperties(MetricsProperties.class) public class MetricsAutoConfiguration extends Object
Spring wiring for the persistent metrics pipeline.

Bean topology

  • MetricsProperties — bound to orchest.metrics.*.
  • MicrometerMetricsRecorder — primary MetricsRecorder, registered when orchest.metrics.enabled=true (the default). Requires a MeterRegistry on the classpath (always present in our apps because Micrometer is a transitive dependency of telemetry).
  • NoOpMetricsRecorder — fallback MetricsRecorder, registered only when no other MetricsRecorder bean exists. Activates automatically in orchest-rest/sentinel when they set orchest.metrics.enabled=false.
  • MetricsFlushService — registered when the pipeline is enabled and a MetricsRepository bean is present (provided by mongo-data-adapter).
